changelog: Signing in no longer makes you wait. Say vibe start and you get the login link immediately with one sentence telling you what to do — no hung command, no blank screen, and it works over SSH or anywhere a browser cannot open. Finish in the browser whenever you like; the next vibe start picks it up. And replies now name their target: every thread in your inbox shows the id of its newest message, and vibe reply answers that exact message instead of guessing the newest one.
features: vibe start signed out returns immediately with the login URL and one instruction — never blocks on the browser
Works headless: over SSH or with no browser, the link IS the next step (and it says so honestly)
Sign-in completes in the background; the next vibe start recognizes it and unlocks the full toolset
vibe inbox shows each thread's newest message id (#msg_…) so a reply can name it exactly
vibe reply answers that exact message — with no target it lists the ids instead of guessing
